subject: ZenPort: Request for prioritized feature inclusion and temporary concession
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@zenport.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@zenport.com>
Date: 2028-03-12T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Feature ask to close ZP-348 — tenant affinity + export clause

Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo this week. ZenPort is excited about Redwood’s throughput and the cost picture looks promising — we’re at the stage where legal and procurement want a stronger commitment on two items before we sign:

1) Tenant-level model affinity (so we can guarantee model residency for high-sensitivity flows).
2) Export/audit log TTL and an explicit retention/export clause for our compliance team.

Both are deal breakers for us. Our CEO is pushing to sign by EOD Friday to hit Q1 targets. I attached an updated mutual action plan (MAP) with proposed dates and the procurement redlines. Can Redwood commit to prioritizing these items or offer a short-term concession (e.g., an SLA credit or a temporary dedicated lane) to bridge until the features are shipped?

If helpful, I can hop on a 20-minute call with your product lead today.

Alex Morgan
Head of Platform Partnerships
ZenPort
alex.morgan@zenport.com
+1 415-555-0182

Subject: Fwd: Feature ask to close ZP-348 — tenant affinity + export clause

Team — forwarding ZenPort’s note. High urgency: they want tenant-level model affinity and defined export/retention language. CEO-level cadence to sign by EOD Friday.

Asks:
- Ben: can Sales propose a short-term commercial concession (SLA credit or dedicated lane) that buys us 60–90 days? What number moves the needle?
- Jasmine: can you run feasibility on a scoped delivery (MVP) for tenant model affinity — narrow scope focusing on routing + residency for a single model and 30k qps peak? Rough ETA and engineering effort estimate please.
- Irene: compliance/product — what’s the minimal export/retention contractual language we can accept that aligns with our current telemetry/export capabilities? Any blockers for a 90-day temporary exception?

I’ve attached their MAP and redlines. If product needs a call with Alex, please propose times.

Thanks — Marissa

Date: 2028-03-12T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Feature ask to close ZP-348 — tenant affinity + export clause

Marissa —

I ran quick economics with Rev Ops. Short-term concession options that are likely approvable by Sales leadership:

- Option A (Preferred): 3 months of a 15% usage credit applied to hosted usage (up to $50k cap) + a commitment to prioritize for Dedicated lanes.
- Option B: Temporary dedicated throughput lane (soft isolation) for 60 days while we push the roadmap; requires ops sign-off but buys them production-level latency.

If Product confirms an ETA under 8 weeks for an MVP, we can go with Option A and push the customer to agree to a staged rollout (pilot -> GA). If engineering says longer, Option B might be the only way to keep them during build.

I’ll prep a short amendment and pricing language for legal if we decide.

-ben
Ben Carter
Head of Strategic Sales | Redwood Inference
From: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@zenport.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@zenport.com>
Date: 2028-03-12T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Feature ask to close ZP-348 — tenant affinity + export clause

Marissa/Ben —

Quick technical readout after syncing with the runtime team: we can scope an MVP for tenant-level model affinity but it requires three focused changes:

1) Route pinning per-tenant to a model variant + residency flag (routing policy change) — estimated 2.5 engineer-weeks to implement and test.
2) A one-off migration/seed to populate KV cache affinity for the tenant (ops + infra playbook) — 1 engineer-week + ops runbook.
3) Small audit/exporter config to allow scheduled export snapshots (not full legal-grade retention work) — 1 engineer-week to enable and document.

Conservative end-to-end ETA: 5–7 weeks if we pull a small squad and deprioritize a couple low-impact items. That fits in Ben’s 8-week threshold.

Risk/notes: full resident model isolation (multi-tenant security guarantees) is not in scope for the MVP; this is a residency-affinity for a known model and known traffic pattern. Any contractual language must reflect the limited scope — otherwise legal will request SRE isolation commitments we can’t meet yet.

Irene — can you draft suggested contract language that matches the MVP capability? I’ll book time on Alex’s calendar for an alignment call if we want to walk through technical tradeoffs.

— Jasmine
Jasmine Liu | Senior PM, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference
From: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@zenport.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@zenport.com>, ZenPort Legal <legal@zenport.com>
Date: 2028-03-13T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Feature ask to close ZP-348 — tenant affinity + export clause

Alex/Priya —

Thanks for the clarity and for sending the MAP. From a compliance/contracting perspective, we can accept a time-limited concession that matches the technical MVP Jasmine outlined. Draft language we propose:  

- Redwood will provide tenant-affinity routing for the specified model(s) for an initial pilot period of up to 90 days. This pilot provides residency-affinity but does not constitute guaranteed physical isolation or separate tenancy.
- Audit exports: Redwood will provide scheduled export snapshots of request/response telemetry for the pilot tenant with a retention window of 90 days. Any requests for longer retention or full export of raw logs will require a separate agreement and may incur additional fees.
- If ZenPort signs the MAP and fully executes the contract by 2028-03-16, Redwood agrees to prioritize the pilot and allocate a small engineering squad to deliver the MVP within 6 weeks.

Ben — based on Jasmine’s ETA and the proposed commercial concession, Sales can offer Option A (15% usage credit, up to $50k) as a bridge while we deliver. We should include a DocuSign link for the amendment (I referenced the DocuSign in the MAP).

Alex/Priya — please confirm that this language is sufficient to route to your procurement/legal, or highlight any redlines. If acceptable, Ben/Marissa — please send the amendment and DocuSign link and we’ll start engineering the pilot next week.

Best,
Irene Choi
Director, Platform Compliance & Product Policy | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai
